{{Top|leg}}
'''Glasteel''' was an alloy developed before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. As strong as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], this transparent material was used to form the large windows of [[Skyscraper/Legends|spacescrapers]], which were built into the superstructure.
